zh-CN.title: 在广场，直接听见
items: 音乐以虚化封面和 CD 造型展示，音乐与音频可在瀑布流中直接播放
发言卡片更紧凑，照片集增加 StillFolio 标识，媒体比例限定为 2:3–3:2
默认使用瀑布流，手机信息流两侧贴边，仍可自行切换列表

en.title: Listen right in Square
items: Music uses a blurred album backdrop and CD cover; play music and audio directly in the feed
More cohesive cards, StillFolio collection branding and media ratios between 2:3 and 3:2
Masonry is now the default with edge-to-edge phone layouts; List remains available
